---
name: Security or content safety concern
about: Report a repository security issue, unsafe content, misleading claim, or risky resource
labels: security, triage
---

## Report type

Select the closest category: repository configuration or dependency; exposed secret; malicious or compromised link; unsafe operational content; misleading benchmark or performance claim; incorrect project status; privacy or data exposure; other.

## Affected content

Provide the file, section, entry, or URL. Use a canonical source where possible.

## Why this matters

Explain the security, safety, accuracy, or user-impact concern. Do not include credentials, personal data, unpublished vulnerability details, exploit payloads, or instructions for unauthorized access.

## Safe evidence

Provide public, non-sensitive evidence or a safe way to verify the issue. If the report is sensitive, follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) rather than opening a public issue.

## Suggested correction

Describe the safe correction, label, removal, or replacement you recommend.
